column1: # catalog/deployment-literals.tsv — BH-4080: the families of DEPLOYMENT literals
# (our org, our hosts, our logins, our accounts) that production code must not
# carry outside its one documented-default home.
# docs/config-inventory/deployment.{json,md} report it writes on every run).
#   family   short name, printed on every hit and named in the allowlist
#   regex    Python `re` pattern, matched against non-comment code lines
#   home     where the value lives instead: space-separated knob names
#            documented defaults the report prints) and/or free text
#   note     one line for the report
# ORDER MATTERS. Rows are tried top to bottom and a match is masked before the
# next row runs, so `operator@example.com` is one billing-account hit, not also an
# operator-login hit, and `example-org/cromford` is harness-repo, not gh-org.
# Keep the most specific rows first.
